title: On Banning the old song outright
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：ban　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ban 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the fisherman ① banned the old song outright twice over, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② bans the old song outright year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ban the old song outright at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ banned the old song outright before — a line in the logbook for July 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Banning the old song outright twice over, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ ban the little pamphlets year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Ban the little pamphlets at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ bans the little pamphlets twice over every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ banned the old song outright again when nobody else would.

⑩ To ban the old song outright, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody bans the old song outright year after year again and somebody must ban the old song outright twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 禁止（一般过去式 banned the old song outright：1953 年渔人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 禁止（一般现在 bans the old song outright：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 禁止（不定式 to ban the old song outright：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 禁止（过去完成时 had banned the old song outright：1947 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 禁止（动名词 banning the old song outright 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 查禁（ban the little pamphlets：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去查禁那些薄薄的小册子）
G. v. 查禁（ban the little pamphlets：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 禁止（后段两处：新来的船工照例 bans the little pamphlets，而母亲又一次 banned the old song outright）

items.q: to ban the old song outright
banned the old song outright before
ban the little pamphlets year after year
ban the little pamphlets at once
bans the little pamphlets twice over
banned the old song outright again
to ban the old song outright

answers.why: ban 意为“禁止”，1953 年渔人来回两遍禁止干脆禁止那首老歌，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 banned。
ban 意为“禁止”，自那以后渔人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bans。
ban 意为“禁止”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯禁止干脆禁止那首老歌”，此处为不定式 to ban the old song outright。
ban 意为“禁止”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人禁止过，故用过去完成时 had banned。
ban 意为“禁止”，渔人说“禁止干脆禁止那首老歌这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 banning the old song outright 作主语。
ban 意为“查禁”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去查禁那些薄薄的小册子”，should ever 之后用原形 ban the little pamphlets。
ban 意为“查禁”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻查禁那些薄薄的小册子（ban the little pamphlets at once），以后再也不要提起。
ban 意为“禁止”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例查禁那些薄薄的小册子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bans。
ban 意为“禁止”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍禁止干脆禁止那首老歌，用一般过去式 banned 叙述。
ban 意为“禁止”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要禁止干脆禁止那首老歌，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

多年以后，渔人仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（bans the old song outright）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯禁止干脆禁止那首老歌这件事本身。（to ban the old song outright）
早在 1947 年就有人禁止干脆禁止那首老歌，七月那天航海日志上的一行字就是证据。（had banned the old song outright）
渔人说过，来回两遍禁止干脆禁止那首老歌这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（banning the old song outright 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻查禁那些薄薄的小册子，以后再也不要提起。（ban the little pamphlets，祈使句）

Three seasons on, the fisherman still bans the old song outright year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to ban the old song outright at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had banned the old song outright long before 1960, and the line in the logbook for July proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ban 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the fisherman banned the old song outright twice over, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman bans the old song outright year after year whenever the harbour asks.
Banning the old song outright twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever ban the little pamphlets year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour bans the little pamphlets twice over every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother banned the old song outright again, and the harbour remembered that half.
